{{Quote|The tour program is expected to focus on recent Neoclassical compositions favored by the Emperor, including several selections from Harbin-re opera, ''[&hellip;]''.|A news report by Imperial HoloVision|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Harbin-re''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|18|Harbin-re}}</ref> located in the [[Harbin-re system/Legends|Harbin-re system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was famous for productions of [[Harbin-re opera|operas]] from the [[Neoclassical period]], including several [[Neoclassical music|compositions]] favored by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[0 ABY/Legends|35:10:16]], the Harbin-re [[Opera/Legends|opera]] was mentioned in an [[Imperial HoloVision]] news report.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harbin-re was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5]], which was published in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Harbin-re [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
